test_isolation_safety.reason: Sourcing /etc/casescope/casescope.env points selected tests at production PostgreSQL and ClickHouse.

production_touching_tests.risk: Writes to PostgreSQL using CASESCOPE_POSTGRES_TEST_DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_URL; with casescope.env loaded this falls back to production DATABASE_URL.
Uses real ClickHouse client to insert rows into events and issue ALTER TABLE events DELETE on reserved high case IDs.
Uses real ClickHouse client for read-only selector parity SELECT when ClickHouse is reachable.

recommended_safe_overrides: Do not source full production casescope.env for non-destructive discovery comparisons.
Set CASESCOPE_POSTGRES_TEST_DATABASE_URL to a disposable PostgreSQL database or unset DATABASE_URL so PostgreSQL tests skip.
Run ClickHouse-mutating regression tests only against a disposable ClickHouse database or exclude them from non-destructive comparisons.
